### Why Cocaine Might Be Considered for Athletic Performance
Cocaine, a powerful stimulant derived from the coca plant, has historically been associated with enhanced physical performance due to its effects on the central nervous system. It blocks the reuptake of dopamine, norepinephrine, and serotonin, leading to increased alertness, euphoria, reduced fatigue perception, and heightened energy levels. Athletes in endurance sports or high-intensity activities might seek it out for these reasons, as it can temporarily mask pain and exhaustion, allowing for sustained effort beyond normal limits. For instance, in the early 20th century, cyclists like those in the Tour de France reportedly used cocaine to combat drowsiness during grueling multi-day races.
